name: Sakata Kanoko
source:
Daughter of Sakata Ryokan and Yukie's only daughter. She is Junpei's cousin.

After graduating from high school, she left her hometown to become a female college student. This time, she is returning to her hometown to help out at the inn (She is aware that she is the innkeeper's daughter, after all...).

Her free-spirited personality is still the same. She still swims in the river in the nude and is as healthy as ever.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokunatsu.html]official site[/url]]
